scientific_integrity: The gain identity is established elementary prior-model calculus, not claimed novel. Novelty assessment concerns the sharp strict-reentry boundary and explicit globally optimal witness. Exact enumeration corroborates an analytic proof; no independent audit is implied.
scientific_limitations: Uniform independent pollinator extinction probability, one perfectly protected pollinator and one-step all-neighbors-lost plant coextinction only.
Thirteen-plant minimum is conditional on precisely four pollinators; no total-vertex minimum for all primary-guild sizes is asserted.
Distinct plant taxa may have identical partner sets; no claim about observed ecosystems or practical effect sizes.
title: Sharp first reentry of optimal pollinator protection
